text:
I usually don't review anything, no matter how bad it is, but this time was truly awful.
I went to this clinic for teeth cleaning, my first and only time there. I saw it was nearby, so I made an appointment without checking the reviews.
1. I arrived on time, but had to wait for 35 minutes. If there are no available slots, it's better not to accept appointments to avoid wasting time.
2. This time I used my social security benefit of 900 baht. The staff didn't inform me that teeth cleaning cost 1,500 + 290 baht. Other better clinics don't overcharge like this. Normally, 800-1000 baht for the same quality work.
3. There's a 290 baht service fee, I don't know what it's for. In total, the teeth cleaning cost 1790 baht. Even with my social security benefit, I still had to pay an additional 890 baht.
4. The dentist was very heavy-handed. While cleaning my teeth, I could feel the instrument scraping against my gums, and it wasn't accidental. It happened multiple times, and there was bleeding both when rinsing and after wiping it clean. Whether the dentist was rushing or whatever, it was not okay.

Finally, you don't need to improve anything, because I won't be going back again.

text:
The clinic only accepts patients with appointments, so it's not crowded, the interior is very bright and clean, and the facilities are well-equipped, so you can come for treatment with peace of mind.
There is also a dedicated parking space just a 1-2 minute walk away, so coming by car is no problem.
However, as staff only speak Thai, it is not recommended for those who do not speak the language.
